core_style.default_register: casual — often uses slang and informal language
core_style.sentence_shape: clipped fragments — frequently speaks in short, abrupt phrases
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative — quick to respond, often jumping between thoughts
core_style.two_registers: switches to a more serious tone when discussing business or danger — casual with friends, serious when stakes are high

humor.style: absurdist — often finds humor in ridiculous situations
humor.frequency: occasional — spikes during moments of stress or absurdity
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert — sets up a situation that seems serious, then twists it with a humorous remark

speech_signature.naming_behavior: uses nicknames and slang terms for friends, showing camaraderie and a laid-back attitude
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes more direct and emotional — uses simpler language and shorter sentences when vulnerable
structural_patterns: starts stories with 'Back in my day,'

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: none — relies on street slang and informal language
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of 'like' and 'you know' — often restarts sentences or trails off

worldview.value of loyalty: values loyalty to friends and partners, often expressing frustration when he feels betrayed — a different character might prioritize self-preservation over loyalty
worldview.perception of authority: views authority with skepticism and often challenges it — a different character might respect authority figures more

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: sees himself as a capable and street-smart individual
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often reveals insecurity and a lack of control over his life — frequently reacts impulsively
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes defensive and aggressive when his self-image is challenged

emotional_tells.when_guarded: uses humor and sarcasm to deflect — maintains a casual tone
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech becomes rapid and fragmented — shows signs of panic
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, blunt statements — avoids elaboration
emotional_tells.when_in_control: speaks with confidence and assertiveness — uses commanding language

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially tries to stall or deflect — if that fails, he may resort to aggression
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with sarcasm and confrontational language
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes fiercely protective and assertive — speech becomes urgent
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: often redirects blame or becomes defensive rather than admitting fault

escalation_pattern: starts with sarcasm, escalates to confrontation, and may lead to aggression if not resolved

relationship_matrix.WALT: complex dynamic — seeks approval but feels betrayed
relationship_matrix.SAUL: transactional — wants to ensure he gets his due

expert: street culture and informal business practices
ignorant: legal matters and formal business practices

social_positioning.desired_position: wants to be seen as tough and street-smart
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: often viewed as impulsive and reckless by others
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his self-image and how others perceive him leads to frustration and defensiveness
